column1: 1. Cache result cached provides when cache lookup occurs before source retrieval.
2. Source decoding attempted does not provide when source lines are not split yet.
3. Loader.get_source attempted too early when module name is not verified.
4. Cache result stored too late when source has already been returned to caller.
5. Result tuple created out of order when cache result is stored before source lines are decoded.
6. Source line splitting stopped too soon when line count is prematurely capped.
7. Encoding detection performed applied for too long when first two lines are processed repeatedly.
8. Result tuple returned does not provide when cache miss leads directly to return without validation.
9. Return result issued too early when result tuple is returned before final encoding applied.
10. Cache update stopped too soon when cache is invalidated prematurely due to concurrent modifications.
